statement: A fixture problem statement, long enough to satisfy the schema floor.

choices.misconception: I only counted the squares that sit on the outer border.
I counted the rows but forgot to count the final column.
I counted every corner twice because two edges meet there.
I used the number of gridlines instead of the number of cells.

hints: Every row holds the same number of cells, so count one row and multiply.
There are four rows of four cells, so there are sixteen cells in total.

solutions.reliable: Count the cells in one row, then multiply by the number of rows. Four times four is sixteen.

whyOnTest: Fixture problems exercise the validator, not a student.
